ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; visible area consists of approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central fluke surface and 15% low-intensity black pixels localized to the perimeter and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions cover the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous, irregular band along the trailing edge and distal tips, with minor isolated dark pixel clusters visible proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an approximate divergence angle of 145 degrees and a narrow vertical depth relative to the horizontal width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration profile extracted along the continuous linear boundary; irregular peak-to-valley pixel transitions are more pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct upward concave trajectory originating from the median notch and terminating in elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of irregular, high-contrast pixel formations localized at the terminal distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular topography and degradation of the linear edge at both distal tips, indicating historical physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigment density along the trailing edge, where the low-intensity black band is visibly thicker and more irregular on the inner-right lobe compared to the inner-left lobe.
